fanout.description: Maximum number of parallel connections to hosts.

command_timeout.description: Command execution timeout in seconds. 0 means no timeout.

color.description: Color output mode: auto, always, or never.

history_size.description: Number of commands stored in history.

maxrc.description: Whether to stop processing commands on non-zero exit code.

node_count.description: Whether to display the number of nodes in results.

confdir.description: List of directories to search for configuration files.
